name: @qf-jarvis/core-decision-adapter
description: QF Jarvis QuickFurno Core decision adapter foundation (QFJ-M3). A concrete implementation of the M2 CoreDecisionPort behind a narrow injected transport: it converts a revision-bound proposal into a versioned Core command, obtains the response through the injected transport (missing transport -> CORE_UNAVAILABLE; exception/timeout normalized fail-closed; deterministic idempotency), and strictly validates response identity. A double state gate re-checks revision/takeover/pause/cancel/assignment/privacy before transport and after response. Only a Core response yields ACCEPTED (never fabricated/upgraded); ACCEPTED is approved only, never sent/delivered/executed/persisted. PROPOSED protocol pending Core-side adoption; no live Core/network/auth/secret, no WhatsApp/n8n/send, no persistence/DB, no live model/RAG. Depends on @qf-jarvis/agent-runtime and zod.
